name: Fallout Tactics Classic
description: Fallout Tactics Classic is a singleplayer and multiplayer isometric tactical role-playing game in the Fallout series.

gog.store_details: This is the older 'Classic' GOG product some existing owners' libraries still show, from before GOG relisted the game. It's the same game, with the same EAX support.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Fallout Tactics starts on Miles' 2D positional audio, so there's no 3D sound and no reverb.
